supplement.text: Different flagpoles and regions require specific attachment hardware. At Wolflag, we equip our reinforced flag headers with your choice of **webbing loops, plastic C-hooks, snap clips, metal swivel hooks, figure-8 rings, or traditional rope and wooden toggles**. Simply specify your preferred finishing style when requesting a quote, and we will manufacture your flags ready for immediate installation.
supplement.imageAlt: Wolflag custom flag finishing options grid showing webbing loops, plastic snap hooks, metal swivel clips, figure-8 hooks, and rope with wooden toggle.
supplement.title: Custom Flag Hardware & Finishing Options

supplement.text:
Choose how your design looks on the back side (front is always identical):

**Single Reverse (Mirror Back)**
• Single-layer dye print where the back shows a mirrored image—lightweight and best for flying flags.
• Materials: knitted polyester, Spun Polyester, & Nylon

**Single-Sided (Blank Back)**
• Printed on one side with a blank white back—ideal for wall banners and backdrops.
• Materials: Vinyl, Satin, & Oxford

**Double-Sided (Reads Correctly)**
• Two layers sewn with a blockout liner so text reads correctly on both sides (or print two different designs).
• Materials:  knitted Polyester, Satin, & Vinyl
supplement.imageAlt: Wolflag custom flag and banner printing comparison diagram showing front view versus single reverse, single-sided, and double-sided back views.
supplement.title: Select Your Printing Option
